source.title: Call for Applicants - WAT Members (October 2022)
source.content:
The WCA Archive Team (WAT) is seeking motivated and trustworthy members! This call for applicants is open to everyone; it's not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

Are you interested in cubing stories of the past and retelling them? Do you enjoy learning about records, major championships and key figures in cubing history? Do you have a habit of collecting objects from past WCA competitions? Do you enjoy writing about speedcubing? If yes, then you may be a great fit for the WAT!

**What does the WAT do?**

* Gather and organize information and media relevant to the WCA's past, present and future.
* Create and compile written/visual content to provide a narrative structure to the Records page, major championships and the WCA in general.
* Collaborate with other teams in producing WCA promotional material.
* Provide coverage of major WCA championships where feasible.
* Keep track of the WCA's historical timeline and ensure all content is up-to-date.

The official rights and duties of the WAT as described in the Motions of the WCA can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.12 - Archive Team.pdf).

**Members are expected to have:**

* Good written English. 
* Time commitment of 3-5 hours per week.
* Interpersonal and communication skills.
* Familiarity with WCA activities.

Other qualities which are useful to have but are not required include:

* Fluency in another language(s).
* Experience in any form of journalism or writing.
* Good communication and interviewing skills.
* Experience and familiarity with Google G-Suite.

If you are interested in joining the WCA Archive Team, please send an application to WAT Leader, William Gan ([wgan@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:wgan@worldcubeassociation.org)). If you have any questions, please do not hesitate in reaching out first before sending your application.

**The application document must be in PDF format, and should include:**

* A brief personal introduction
* A summary of your involvement with the WCA and cubing community
* Your motivation to join the WAT
* Any additional experience or personal skills relevant to the WAT

Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of their application within 24 hours. The application deadline is **November 19th 2022 23:59 UTC**. Applications will be reviewed and discussed among the current WAT members and a decision will be made about 2-3 weeks after the deadline. 

Thank you for your interest in joining the WAT, we look forward to receiving your applications!

translation.title: WCA 档案组成员招募（2022 年 10 月）
translation.content:
WCA 档案组（WAT）正在招募积极、可靠的新成员！所有人均可申请，无须已在 WCA 任职。

你是否对魔方圈过去的故事感兴趣，也愿意把它们讲给别人？你是否喜欢了解魔方史上的纪录、大型锦标赛和重要人物？你是否习惯收藏以往 WCA 比赛的物品？你是否喜欢写速拧相关的文章？如果是，你可能很适合加入 WAT！

**WAT 的工作是什么？**

* 收集和整理与 WCA 过去、现在和未来有关的信息及媒体资料。
* 撰写、制作和整理文字及视觉内容，用连贯的叙述介绍纪录页面、大型锦标赛及 WCA 的整体历史。
* 与其他团队合作制作 WCA 宣传资料。
* 在条件允许时报道 WCA 大型锦标赛。
* 维护 WCA 的历史时间线，确保各项内容及时更新。

WCA 决议中对 WAT 正式权利和职责的规定见[此处](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.12 - Archive Team.pdf)。

**我们希望成员具备：**

* 良好的英语写作能力。
* 每周能投入 3–5 小时。
* 良好的人际交往与沟通能力。
* 熟悉 WCA 的活动。

以下能力有帮助，但不是硬性要求：

* 流利使用另一种或多种语言。
* 有任何形式的新闻报道或写作经验。
* 良好的沟通和采访能力。
* 熟悉 Google G-Suite，并有使用经验。

如有意加入 WCA 档案组，请将申请发送给 WAT 负责人 William Gan（[wgan@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:wgan@worldcubeassociation.org)）。如有疑问，欢迎在提交申请前先联系我们。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 参与 WCA 和魔方社区的经历总结。
* 申请加入 WAT 的原因。
* 其他与 WAT 工作相关的经验或个人技能。

申请人将在 24 小时内收到确认收件的回复。申请截止时间为 **2022 年 11 月 19 日 23:59 UTC**。现任 WAT 成员将审核和讨论申请，并在截止后约 2–3 周作出决定。

感谢你有意加入 WAT，期待收到你的申请！
